# Save.ps1 - the server saves one of its own files back to the engine repo, so a change made on the

$gh = Get-Content (Join-Path $Dir "github.json") -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$hdr = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $($gh.token)"; Accept = "application/vnd.github+json"; "User-Agent" = "LetHimCook-Server" }
$api = "https://api.github.com/repos/$Repo/contents/" + ($Path -replace "\\", "/")
$sha = $null; try { $sha = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($api + "?ref=$Branch") -Headers $hdr -TimeoutSec 20).sha } catch {}
$body = @{ message = "server: $Path " + (Get-Date -Format "ddd h:mm tt"); content = [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($src)); branch = $Branch }; if ($sha) { $body.sha = $sha }
$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri $api -Headers $hdr -ContentType "application/json" -Body ($body | ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 60
# bring the repo clone up to date so the next pull sees no difference and copies nothing back

function Log($m) { Add-Content $log ("{0}  {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "ddd HH:mm:ss"), $m) }
